mapper.select: SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_application ba WHERE ba.basecamp_id = b.id AND ba.applicant_id = #{reporterId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_member bm WHERE bm.basecamp_id = b.id AND bm.member_id = #{reporterId})) AS reporter_involved, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_application ba WHERE ba.basecamp_id = b.id AND ba.applicant_id = #{targetId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM basecamp_member bm WHERE bm.basecamp_id = b.id AND bm.member_id = #{targetId})) AS target_involved, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_report mr WHERE mr.reporter_id = #{reporterId} AND mr.target_member_id = #{targetId} AND mr.basecamp_id = b.id AND mr.kind = #{kind}) AS already_reported, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review cr WHERE cr.id = #{companionReviewId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND cr.basecamp_id = b.id AND cr.reviewer_id = #{targetId} AND cr.reviewee_id = #{reporterId} AND cr.hidden_at IS NULL) AS review_matches, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review cr WHERE cr.basecamp_id = b.id AND cr.reviewer_id = #{reporterId} AND cr.reviewee_id = #{targetId}) AS reverse_written, b.completed_at AS completed_at FROM basecamp b WHERE b.id = #{basecampId}
